test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To lead one by the nose

options.text: To try again after failing at something
To have the freedom to choose
To be anxious to start something

solution:
The correct answer is** 'To control someone completely'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'To lead one by the nose'** is** 'To control someone completely'.**
 
• **To lead one by the nose:** to control someone and make them do exactly what you want. (किसी को नियंत्रित करने के लिए और उन्हें ठीक वही करने के लिए जो आप चाहते हैं)
 
 
• *Example: I'm amazed that he lets them **lead him around by the nose** like that.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *To control someone completely.*
